title: The applies_to range of mods.md ends at 2026-10-17 and 2026-10-18, while the create page it now cites is dated 2026-10-20 and was read 2026-10-24
goal: The applies_to front matter of kb/public/claude/mods.md gives the dateModified range and the read date of every page the article cites, the create page included

run:
import re, sys
t = open("kb/public/claude/mods.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
m = re.search(r"^applies_to:.*$", t, re.M)
line = m.group(0) if m else ""
stale = "2026-10-08 to 2026-10-17" in line
print("applies_to range:", line[:200], "| stale (misses the 2026-10-20 create page):", stale)
sys.exit(1 if stale else 0)
